title: More controls for community image-making
summary:
Two community image generators joined Creative Projects, and the text API’s root now points to its documentation.

Rishabh Mishra’s React-based image generator was added to Creative Projects, with style, quality and resolution controls and a history of generated images.

CVRON AI, an image generator built with the Pollinations API, was added to Creative Projects with a Turkish-language tag and an English description.

The root of text.pollinations.ai now redirects to the API documentation instead of the community UI.
